title: RDTII Hand-off #2 Provision-Record
description: One grounded provision per line of provisions.jsonl (contract section 3.3). Grounding rule (3.2): verbatim_snippet MUST equal source_text/<doc_id>.txt[snippet_char_start:snippet_char_end]; the schema checks shape, the validate CLI checks the assertion. Includes the PATCH-additive provenance fields from PLAN.md 2.4.3a/2.6b (snippet_source, grounded-metadata offsets, processing_time_seconds, model_version) - optional-with-null, backward-compatible per contract section 8.

provision_id.description: <doc_id>#<article_section>, or <doc_id>#a<act_index>#<section> when one document holds several acts, as a Timorese gazette issue does.

doc_id.description: Stable join key <cc>-<lawslug>-<seq>, e.g. sg-pdpa2012-001 or la-la2537-001. A two-letter class since 0.3.0, so a seventh economy needs no schema edit.

law_name_grounded.description: True when law_name bytes were copied from source_text (2.6b); false when carried from the manifest guess.

source_url.description: Exact URL the bytes came from, or null when none was recorded and none can be established without guessing - see source_url_basis.

obligation_type.description: Non-exclusive soft prefilter hint (contract 3.3 boundary note) - NEVER the indicator decision.

extraction_model.description: The model that produced this record's tags, or null when none has run. Never the configured default (contract 5.2).

model_version.description: LLM_MODEL plus '+<ocr_engine>' only when the record was actually OCR'd (contract 5.2).

access_date.description: ISO-8601 UTC retrieval time with a trailing Z, or null when no such instant was ever observed - see access_date_basis. A null here is a recorded gap, not a missing value.

law_name_en_source.description: Where the English title came from. source_is_english: the law is published in English, so the title is the original and nothing was translated. rendered: machine-made and labelled as such. publisher_translation: an official English edition exists and this is its printed title.

citation_confidence.description: How the article number was arrived at. exact: the text printed it and it continues the run. sequence_repaired: the text printed something else and position was trusted instead - article_number_as_read keeps what was read. sequence_restart: the number dropped sharply AND a new ascending run begins from it, which is a new instrument starting inside the same document, so the TEXT is trusted and nothing is repaired.

tags_source.description: Where scope/data_type/obligation_type came from. 'llm': a model judged this provision and extraction_model names it. 'llm_failed': the model was called and errored, so the fields are the fallback and extraction_confidence is 0.0. 'not_tagged': no model has run, the three fields are null, and extraction_model is null. A record must never carry a model name that did not produce its tags.

access_date_basis.description: What the retrieval time actually rests on. 'http_fetch_utc': a second-precision UTC instant was recorded at fetch, and access_date carries it. 'collector_local_naive': a real instant was recorded without a timezone. 'collector_date_only': a date, no time. 'bulk_export_session_naive': the timestamp of the bulk download session, not of this document. 'not_observed': nothing was recorded. access_date is non-null ONLY for http_fetch_utc - every other basis leaves it null and puts the collector's own string in access_date_observed, because a fabricated instant in this column is worse than an admitted gap.

access_date_observed.description: The retrieval time exactly as collection recorded it, in whatever shape - '2026-09-21T00:39:38', '2026-09-22', '20260921_222525', '(resumed)'. Never reformatted, so the original evidence survives.

source_url_basis.description: What source_url points at. 'document_address': it resolves to THIS document. 'database_root': the database's own address, because the host publishes no per-document URL and forbids automated collection - trace by law_name_guess plus publication_date. 'parent_page': an attachment, carrying the address of the page that served it. 'source_site': the publishing body's own site, where the document's own address was never recorded but the source is known and documented. 'not_recorded': neither the document nor its source is known and none can be established without guessing; source_url is null. A URL that resolves to a DIFFERENT version of the instrument is not this document's address and must be 'not_recorded'.
